summary: Created `dropbox` as a public-key-only, SFTP-only account chrooted to `/srv/sftp/dropbox`. `/incoming` is writable by the account. Live confinement, upload/download, command rejection, and reboot persistence tests all passed.
actions_performed: Generated a root-protected Ed25519 credential on node1.
Configured `internal-sftp`, chrooting, key-only authentication, and disabled shell/TTY/forwarding access.
Restarted node1 and verified full recovery with preserved data and successful new transfers.

evidence.summary: Shows the account, root-owned 0755 chroot, and writable 0750 incoming directory.
Shows the effective internal-SFTP policy; live tests reject host filesystem access and normal SSH commands.
Live upload/download succeeds with matching hashes; uploaded data is owned by dropbox:sftpusers with mode 0640.
Captures the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, running sshd, persistent configuration/data, and successful post-restart SFTP read/write.
